AgentLimitViolation.description:
One way a run goes beyond what an agent may start.

``limit`` names the bound: one of the profile's ``agent_limits`` keys
when ``source`` is ``'agent_limits'``, a ``ModelSpec`` field when it is
``'model'`` (and ``model`` says which). ``keys`` are the run's setting
keys that produce ``value``; ``value`` is None when the instrument
chooses the quantity itself, and ``allowed`` is None when the profile's
limit is itself not a valid number.
AgentLimitViolation.title: AgentLimitViolation

AgentLimitCheck.description: The verdict on a run an agent would start. ``ok`` when nothing is beyond.
AgentLimitCheck.title: AgentLimitCheck

AgentLimitSettings.description:
What a run an AI agent starts may put on the device. Its own section.

A section beside ``measurement`` rather than more keys inside it, because
these are not settings of a run: the resolver never copies them into one,
so they cannot reach a data file, and a run request only carries
measurement keys. They bound the ``agent`` role only; a run a person
starts is never held to them (``docs/design/mcp_layer.md`` M4).

None is no cap beyond the instrument's own. A cap is a positive, finite
number: 0 would refuse every run, which is what turning agents off is for.

max_current_a.description: Largest |I| an agent's run may source or allow as compliance, in A. None = the instrument's own limit.
max_current_a.title: Max Current A

max_power_w.description: Largest |V| x |I| an agent's run could deliver, in W. None = the instrument's own limit.
max_power_w.title: Max Power W

max_voltage_v.description: Largest |V| an agent's run may source or allow as compliance, in V. None = the instrument's own limit.
max_voltage_v.title: Max Voltage V

AgentLimitSettings.title: AgentLimitSettings

AuxSensorSettings.description:
Auxiliary-sensor co-logging. Serialized inside ``measurement``.

Co-logging is only wired into the continuous modes
(``data_export.AUX_LOG_MODES``); the resolver reports an issue when a
request asks for it on a sweep or vdP run.

aux_address.description: VISA resource of the sensor, e.g. ASRL6::INSTR (serial port COM6 on Windows). Read when aux_log_enabled.
aux_address.title: Aux Address

aux_driver.description: Sensor driver: arduino_thermocouple (a K-type thermocouple board streaming DATA lines) or stream_sensor (a device that names its channels in an HDR line). Read when aux_log_enabled.
aux_driver.title: Aux Driver

aux_log_enabled.description: Log an auxiliary sensor's channels beside each reading, as aux_<key> columns and aux_fault; resistance, source_v, source_i and four_point only.
aux_log_enabled.title: Aux Log Enabled

AuxSensorSettings.title: AuxSensorSettings

CurrentSourceSettings.description: Source I, measure V. ``isource_duration_hours`` of 0 runs until stopped.

isource_voltage_compliance.description: Voltage limit while sourcing isource_current; readings at it are flagged V_COMP.
isource_voltage_compliance.title: Isource Voltage Compliance

isource_voltage_range_auto.description: true: the voltage measurement autoranges; false: it stays on the range that holds isource_voltage_compliance.
isource_voltage_range_auto.title: Isource Voltage Range Auto

CurrentSourceSettings.title: CurrentSourceSettings

DisplaySettings.description: Plot appearance. Frontend-only, modelled so a profile round-trips.
DisplaySettings.title: DisplaySettings

FileSettings.description: Where rows are written and how often they are flushed.
FileSettings.title: FileSettings

FourPointSettings.description:
Four-point probe, with the ASTM F84 correction-factor inputs.

``fpp_temperature_c`` is ``None`` when the temperature was not measured.
The PySide6 UI carries that as a -50 C sentinel on its spin box (the
widget's "not measured" special value) and a profile as NaN. The resolver
shows this model ``None`` in place of NaN and converts nothing in the run
settings: NaN from a profile stays NaN and a JSON client's ``null`` stays
``None``. The consumers read both as "not measured".

fpp_array_angle_deg.description: Direction of the probe array, anticlockwise from +x (a rectangle's length); a spot's own angle_deg wins. Position check only.
fpp_array_angle_deg.title: Fpp Array Angle Deg

fpp_delta_mode.description: Current reversal: each reading combines +I and -I, cancelling thermal offsets.
fpp_delta_mode.title: Fpp Delta Mode

fpp_delta_settling.description: Wait after each reversal, in s.
fpp_delta_settling.title: Fpp Delta Settling

fpp_diameter_cm.description: Sample diameter (or width) for the ASTM F84 F2 correction; 0 = infinite. Above 0 the F84 corrections apply.
fpp_diameter_cm.title: Fpp Diameter Cm

fpp_dopant_type.description: Silicon dopant type for the F84 temperature correction.
fpp_dopant_type.title: Fpp Dopant Type

fpp_edge_warn_pct.description: A spot with a position warns, before its first reading, when the geometry factor there differs by more than this from the one the rows use (from the factor at the sample's centre when they have none).
fpp_edge_warn_pct.title: Fpp Edge Warn Pct

fpp_geometry.description: Sample shape for the F2 correction (rectangle_N: length = N x width). Anything but circle applies the F84 corrections.
fpp_geometry.title: Fpp Geometry

fpp_k_factor.description: Geometric factor K: Rs = K x V/I; 4.532 for an infinite thin sheet.
fpp_k_factor.title: Fpp K Factor

fpp_model.description: By default (thin_film, fpp_k_factor 4.532, fpp_alpha 1, no F84 input) Rs = 4.532 x V/I and rho = Rs x t, with no corrections. thin_film: Rs = K x alpha x V/I; finite_thin: Rs = K x V/I; both rho = Rs x t. semi_infinite: rho = 2 pi s x V/I (bulk, t >> s); finite_alpha: rho = alpha x 2 pi s x V/I; both Rs = K x V/I. Not used when an ASTM F84 input is set (fpp_diameter_cm > 0, fpp_geometry not circle, or fpp_temperature_c with fpp_dopant_type n or p): the F84 corrections apply instead.
fpp_model.title: Fpp Model

fpp_position_correction.description: warn: a spot's position effect (the geometry factor where the probe is, against the one the rows use) is reported, and never applied to Rs or rho. The only choice: whether a position correction may be applied is undecided, so every number in a file is the uncorrected K or F84 one.
fpp_position_correction.title: Fpp Position Correction

fpp_power_stop_w.description: The run refuses to start when |fpp_current| x fpp_voltage_compliance is above this, and with fpp_stop_on_overpower stops when a measured V x I is.
fpp_power_stop_w.title: Fpp Power Stop W

fpp_power_warn_w.description: The run warns when |fpp_current| x fpp_voltage_compliance is above this.
fpp_power_warn_w.title: Fpp Power Warn W

fpp_sample_diameter_mm.description: Diameter of a circle outline; 0 = not entered. Read only when fpp_sample_shape is circle.
fpp_sample_diameter_mm.title: Fpp Sample Diameter Mm

fpp_sample_length_mm.description: Side of a rectangle outline along x, the direction of a 0 deg probe array; 0 = not entered. Read only when fpp_sample_shape is rectangle.
fpp_sample_length_mm.title: Fpp Sample Length Mm

fpp_sample_shape.description: Sample outline for a spot's position check only; unbounded: fpp_geometry and fpp_diameter_cm describe it. circle needs fpp_sample_diameter_mm, rectangle fpp_sample_width_mm and fpp_sample_length_mm.
fpp_sample_shape.title: Fpp Sample Shape

fpp_sample_width_mm.description: Side of a rectangle outline along y, across a 0 deg probe array; 0 = not entered. Read only when fpp_sample_shape is rectangle.
fpp_sample_width_mm.title: Fpp Sample Width Mm

fpp_samples.description: Readings to take, then stop; 0 = until stopped.
fpp_samples.title: Fpp Samples

fpp_spacing_cm.description: Probe tip spacing s (0.1016 cm = 40 mil). Read by semi_infinite and finite_alpha (rho = 2 pi s x V/I), the ASTM F84 corrections and a spot's position check; thin_film and finite_thin do not use it.
fpp_spacing_cm.title: Fpp Spacing Cm

fpp_stop_on_overpower.description: true: a reading whose measured |V x I| is above fpp_power_stop_w turns the output off and ends the run (reason overpower). false: such a reading only warns, as one above fpp_power_warn_w does.
fpp_stop_on_overpower.title: Fpp Stop On Overpower

fpp_temperature_c.description: Silicon sample temperature for the F84 correction to 23 C, with fpp_dopant_type; null = not measured.
fpp_temperature_c.title: Fpp Temperature C

fpp_thickness_um.description: 0 = not given: sheet resistance only, no resistivity or conductivity (fpp_model semi_infinite does not use it). With the ASTM F84 corrections no sheet resistance either: their thickness factor needs it.
fpp_thickness_um.title: Fpp Thickness Um

fpp_voltage_compliance.description: Voltage limit while sourcing fpp_current. Readings at it are flagged V_COMP and their Rs and rho are lower bounds. |fpp_current| x this is the worst-case probe power, judged against fpp_power_warn_w and fpp_power_stop_w.
fpp_voltage_compliance.title: Fpp Voltage Compliance

fpp_voltage_range_auto.description: true: the voltage measurement autoranges; false: it stays on the range that holds fpp_voltage_compliance.
fpp_voltage_range_auto.title: Fpp Voltage Range Auto

FourPointSettings.title: FourPointSettings

InstrumentSettings.description:
Knobs that apply to every mode, wherever the value comes from.

``gpib_address``, ``visa_library``, ``gpib_interface`` and
``allow_agents`` are machine-local — ``ConfigManager`` keeps them in this
machine's own file and injects them into the profile on read, so they are
never stored per user (``config.py``).

allow_agents.description: Let AI agents connect to a backend on this machine, through an MCP server, with a token of their own (role 'agent'). Machine-local; only the 'ui' role may change it.
allow_agents.title: Allow Agents

auto_zero.description: on: re-zero with every reading (slower, no drift); once: zero at the start of the run; off: never.
auto_zero.title: Auto Zero

filter_type.description: repeat: each reading averages filter_count new conversions; moving: a running average.
filter_type.title: Filter Type

gpib_interface.description: Interface resource of a Prologix-style GPIB adapter (Prologix GPIB-USB / GPIB-ETHERNET, AR488), opened before the instrument so that GPIB<board>::<addr>::INSTR resolves; pyvisa-py only. Empty = none. Serial: PRLGX-ASRL[board]::<device>::INTFC, where <device> is the port path on macOS and Linux (PRLGX-ASRL::/dev/cu.usbserial-PX12345::INTFC, PRLGX-ASRL::/dev/ttyUSB0::INTFC) and the COM port number alone on Windows (PRLGX-ASRL::5::INTFC for COM5). Ethernet: PRLGX-TCPIP[board]::<host>[::port]::INTFC, port 1234 by default. [board] defaults to 0 and is the <board> of the instrument address.
gpib_interface.title: Gpib Interface

nplc.description: Integration time per reading, in power-line cycles.
nplc.title: Nplc

sampling_rate.description: Readings per second asked for; the timing settings may allow fewer.
sampling_rate.title: Sampling Rate

stop_on_compliance.description: End the run when the output reaches its compliance limit.
stop_on_compliance.title: Stop On Compliance

InstrumentSettings.title: InstrumentSettings

ResistanceSettings.description: Source I, measure R. 2-wire or 4-wire, optional cable null.

res_auto_range.description: Auto-ohms: the instrument chooses its own test current and voltage limit.
res_auto_range.title: Res Auto Range

res_cable_null.description: Lead resistance subtracted from every reading, in ohms; set by the cable-null procedure.
res_cable_null.title: Res Cable Null

res_measurement_type.description: 4-wire senses the voltage at the sample on separate leads (remote sense); 2-wire includes the leads' resistance.
res_measurement_type.title: Res Measurement Type

res_offset_comp.description: Offset-compensated ohms: cancels thermal EMFs, halves the reading rate.
res_offset_comp.title: Res Offset Comp

res_test_current.description: Current sourced, with res_auto_range off. With it on, auto-ohms chooses the current per range (100 mA seen for a 1 mA request) and the Current column records it; the file name (…_R_1.00mA) and params.test_current_A still give this value.
res_test_current.title: Res Test Current

ResistanceSettings.title: ResistanceSettings

ClientInfo.description:
Which program asked for the run, recorded in the file header.

The backend's own version is always written (``software_version``); this
says what was driving it -- the desktop app, a script, the MCP layer --
so a file written through the API can be told from one the PySide6 app
wrote. Self-reported, so it is provenance and not authentication.
ClientInfo.title: ClientInfo

SpotRequest.description:
One placement of the probe, as the client describes it.

The position is optional -- a spot can be a label and nothing more -- but
``x_mm`` and ``y_mm`` only mean something together. ``angle_deg`` is the
direction of the probe array, anticlockwise from +x; absent, the run uses
the ``fpp_array_angle_deg`` setting.
SpotRequest.title: SpotRequest

RunRequest.description:
What a client asks for. Never persisted.

This is the body ``POST /session/start`` validates, and the model the
desktop's request type is generated from; unknown fields are refused so
a misspelt one cannot be silently ignored.

``overrides`` is flat measurement keys, the same shape the tabs produce
today, so one request format serves the UI, a script and the MCP layer.
Strict validation of the keys happens in the resolver, which knows which
ones the profile owns.
RunRequest.title: RunRequest

SafetySettings.description:
Touch-safety warning threshold. Serialized inside ``measurement``.

``safety_voltage_warn_silenced`` is the sticky per-profile flag behind the
warning dialog's "don't show again" checkbox.
``safety_voltage_warn_silenced_until`` is the timed form, a Unix time:
the warning is silenced until then and back by itself afterwards. An
expired value is ignored, never cleared (``safety.warning_silenced``).

The threshold runs to 1100 V, the 2410's range and the Settings dialog's
maximum: a threshold the dialog can save must not make the profile
unrunnable here. 0 disables the warning. Every key here belongs to the
profile; a strict run request may not send any (``resolve.SAFETY_KEYS``).
SafetySettings.title: SafetySettings

SampleGeometry.description:
The lateral outline of a thin sample with insulating edges.

``unbounded`` means a sheet large enough that its edges do not matter,
which is what the software assumed before it knew about outlines.
SampleGeometry.title: SampleGeometry

SettingsWarning.description:
Something the run will warn about once it is going, said beforehand.

Not an :class:`Issue`: nothing is wrong with the settings, and a start
is never refused for one. The run itself would say it, in a log line
or not at all (a rate it cannot reach is simply not reached); a
preview that stayed silent left a client to find out from the run, or
to work it out for itself and disagree. ``keys`` are the settings the
judgement reads, the one to change first.
SettingsWarning.title: SettingsWarning

SpotRequest.description:
One placement of the probe, as the client describes it.

The position is optional -- a spot can be a label and nothing more -- but
``x_mm`` and ``y_mm`` only mean something together. ``angle_deg`` is the
direction of the probe array, anticlockwise from +x; absent, the run uses
the ``fpp_array_angle_deg`` setting.
SpotRequest.title: SpotRequest

SweepSettings.description:
Bulk linear sweep, run by the instrument's own sweep engine.

Start, stop, step and compliance change unit with ``sweep_source``. Their
``ge``/``le`` are the wider of the two units' limits -- the PySide6 spin
boxes', which do not follow the source -- and the validators below apply
the limit of the unit the value is actually in. For a headless client
the model is the only gate: without them a current-sourced sweep "to
200" validated, and 200 there is amperes.

sweep_compliance.description: Limit on the measured quantity: a current, at most 3.15 A, when sweep_source is voltage; a voltage, at most 210 V, when it is current.
sweep_compliance.title: Sweep Compliance

sweep_delay.description: Delay between sourcing and measuring at each point, in s.
sweep_delay.title: Sweep Delay

sweep_measurement_type.description: 4-wire senses the voltage at the sample on separate leads (remote sense); 2-wire includes the leads' resistance.
sweep_measurement_type.title: Sweep Measurement Type

sweep_start.description: In the source's unit: V, within +/-200, when sweep_source is voltage; A, within +/-3, when it is current.
sweep_start.title: Sweep Start

sweep_step.description: In the source's unit: V, within +/-200, when sweep_source is voltage; A, within +/-3, when it is current.
sweep_step.title: Sweep Step

sweep_stop.description: In the source's unit: V, within +/-200, when sweep_source is voltage; A, within +/-3, when it is current.
sweep_stop.title: Sweep Stop

SweepSettings.title: SweepSettings

VdpSettings.description:
van der Pauw, ASTM F76 Method A.

A thickness of 0 is "not given", as for the four-point probe: the run
reports the sheet resistance and the homogeneity check, which need no
thickness, and no resistivity. It used to be refused, although nothing
but the resistivity reads it.

vdp_readings_per_polarity.description: Readings averaged at each current direction of each wiring.
vdp_readings_per_polarity.title: Vdp Readings Per Polarity

vdp_settling_s.description: Wait after each change of current, in s.
vdp_settling_s.title: Vdp Settling S

vdp_thickness_cm.description: 0 = not given: sheet resistance and the homogeneity check only, no resistivity.
vdp_thickness_cm.title: Vdp Thickness Cm

vdp_voltage_compliance.description: Voltage limit while sourcing vdp_current at each wiring. The touch-safety check and an agent's voltage limit judge the run by it.
vdp_voltage_compliance.title: Vdp Voltage Compliance

vdp_voltage_range_auto.description: true: the voltage measurement autoranges; false: it stays on the range that holds vdp_voltage_compliance.
vdp_voltage_range_auto.title: Vdp Voltage Range Auto

VdpSettings.title: VdpSettings

VoltageSourceSettings.description: Source V, measure I. ``vsource_duration_hours`` of 0 runs until stopped.

vsource_current_compliance.description: Current limit while sourcing vsource_voltage; readings at it are flagged I_COMP.
vsource_current_compliance.title: Vsource Current Compliance

vsource_current_range_auto.description: true: the current measurement autoranges; false: it stays on the range that holds vsource_current_compliance.
vsource_current_range_auto.title: Vsource Current Range Auto

VoltageSourceSettings.title: VoltageSourceSettings
